title: Investigate a UAT defect
summary: Move from symptom to reproduced, root-caused and verified fix. A fix is accepted only with reproduction evidence.

questions.text: What happened, and what should have happened?
questions.why: Expected behavior is the definition of a successful fix.

ask_if.text_lacks: expected result|expected:|expected behaviou?r|should have|instead of|actual result|actual:

questions.text: How can it be reproduced with synthetic or approved test data (steps or inputs)?
questions.why: A failing reproduction lets you prove the fix instead of guessing.

questions.text: Where does it fail (environment, version) and what changed since it last worked?
questions.why: Recent changes are the fastest route to root cause.

questions.text: Do you have sanitized evidence (error message, log line without personal data)?
questions.why: Evidence narrows hypotheses. Remove customer data and secrets first.

questions.text: How do you run the tests for this project?
questions.why: Reproduction must be a test you can run before and after the fix.

staged_actions.instruction: Using the evidence below, list 2-3 plausible causes and the check that would distinguish them. Do not change code yet.
Write a regression test that fails on the current code for the reported behavior. Run it and paste the failing output.
Make the minimal change that makes the regression test pass. Do not weaken or delete existing tests.
Run {test_command}. Show the regression test failing before and passing after, and the full suite passing.

acceptance.text: The change includes (or names) a regression test for the reported behavior.
That regression test fails before the fix (reproduction evidence).
It passes after the fix, and the full suite passes.
No secrets or credentials in the changed or exported files.

evidence_requirements: A test run before the fix
A test run after the fix
teaching_tip: A fix without a failing test first is a guess. Reproduce the defect as a test, then fix it, then show the same test passing.

exercise.prompt: What single piece of evidence would prove this defect is fixed?
exercise.answer_hint: A test that fails on the old code and passes on the new code.
